examples.text: O SUPER HOMEM! Defensor dos oprimidos, a maravilha fisica que havia jurado devotar sua existencia em auxiliar os necessitados.
examples.ref: 1938 December 17, “O Superhomem” (chapter 1), in A Gazetinha Nova Phase, volume VI, number 445, São Paulo, page 5:
examples.english: SUPERMAN! Defender of the oppressed, the physical wonder who had sworn to devote his existence to helping those in need.
